name: tlelosa-claude-config
description: Private Claude Code marketplace for Tebello Lelosa's shared tooling — deployed identically on Operations and the personal Pappa T, kept independent of project content on either machine.

plugins.name: dcoe-roster

Does NOT ship agent bodies — those live at ~/.claude/agents/ per machine; bootstrap a new machine with agent-bodies-reference/bootstrap.sh from this repo.

plugins.name: shared-skills
plugins.description: Cross-project Claude Code Skills: capture, dev-server-staleness-check, safe-office-file-read, reuse-existing-ui-primitive, sweep-shared-ui-convention-fix, verify-ui-cardinality-against-output.

plugins.name: codex-gate
plugins.description: Advisory cross-family second opinion on spec files via /codex-review (OpenAI Codex CLI). Warn-only, never blocks; specs-only payload. Install per machine — only where OpenAI egress is cleared (Pappa T until Operations IT clearance).
